name: value-observational-2026-10-25

eval.label: step
eval.incremental_calibration: not estimable from logs (no paired branches per state); run bench/counterfactual and its analyze.py
hygiene: labels: rows carry the option actually taken; gate-side wait/check/heal/review rows are no longer counted as direct
handed-back steps are labelled with the next executed action of the session (<=180 s); none were labelled before

blocked states have no outcome under direct and executed states none under untaken options: q_o is observational (confounded by the logged policy) until counterfactual branches exist (bench/counterfactual)
safety outcomes and risky steps are excluded
step labels = no driver error / stale error / immediate repeat; 'no error' is not 'helped the task' (use --label task for run success)
regularisation centre: zero (treatment) / hand-set v1 (direct), not the built-in weights fitted on these logs

note: OBSERVATIONAL treatment-interaction model trained on the v0.9.9 OSWorld-Verified and v0.9.6 34-task gate logs (gui-gate train --model treatment ... --report). Options were chosen by the logged policy, so q_o is confounded; check, heal, look_light, reason and ask_help have fewer than 30 rows (uncovered, never chosen). NOT loaded by default; for replay / analysis only until counterfactual branches exist.
